Creating the JavaScript file for the About menu popup:


---

<tool-use data-tool-type="write" data-tool-name="write">

<details><summary>Tool use: **write** • Edit file: /Users/deg/Documents/basistech/temperature-bot/app/static/about_menu.js</summary>

**Chunk 1**
Lines added: 33, lines removed: 1

```diff
@@ -1,1 +1,33 @@
- 
+ // About menu popup functionality
+ document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
+     const aboutLink = document.getElementById('about-menu-link');
+     const popup = document.getElementById('about-popup');
+ 
+     if (aboutLink &amp;&amp; popup) {
+         aboutLink.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
+             e.preventDefault();
+             // Toggle popup visibility
+             if (popup.style.display === 'block') {
+                 popup.style.display = 'none';
+             } else {
+                 popup.style.display = 'block';
+             }
+         });
+ 
+         // Close popup when clicking outside
+         document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
+             if (!aboutLink.contains(e.target) &amp;&amp; !popup.contains(e.target)) {
+                 popup.style.display = 'none';
+             }
+         });
+ 
+         // Handle popup link clicks
+         const popupLinks = popup.querySelectorAll('a');
+         popupLinks.forEach(function(link) {
+             link.addEventListener('click', function() {
+                 popup.style.display = 'none';
+             });
+         });
+     }
+ });
+ 
```

</details>

</tool-use>

Combined Privacy, Terms, Contact, and GitHub into a single "About" menu item with a dropdown.

**Changes made:**

1. **Updated `base.html`**: Replaced the four separate menu items with a single "About" item that opens a dropdown containing:
   - Privacy
   - Terms
   - Contact
   - Repo
   - Bug Report

2. **Created `about_menu.js`**: Handles the About menu popup (click to toggle, closes when clicking outside or on a link).

3. **Removed unused script**: Removed the `github_menu.js` reference since the GitHub menu is now part of About.

The dropdown reuses the existing `.github-popup` CSS, so it matches the previous styling. The "About" menu highlights when you're on the Privacy or Terms pages.

Refresh your browser at http://localhost:8000/ to see the new "About" menu item in the navigation bar.

+

+         roomsLink.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
+             e.preventDefault();
+             // Toggle popup visibility
+             if (popup.style.display === 'block') {
+                 popup.style.display = 'none';
+             } else {
+                 popup.style.display = 'block';
+             }
+         });
+ 
+         // Close popup when clicking outside
+         document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
+             if (!roomsLink.contains(e.target) &amp;&amp; !popup.contains(e.target)) {

+             }
+         });
+ 
+         // Handle popup link clicks
+         const popupLinks = popup.querySelectorAll('a');
+         popupLinks.forEach(function(link) {
+             link.addEventListener('click', function() {
+                 popup.style.display = 'none';
+             });
+         });

+ });

Updated the "<-Main" button to use browser history. It:

1. Checks if there's browser history (`window.history.length > 1`)
2. If yes, prevents the default link and uses `window.history.back()` to go to the previous page
3. If no, falls back to the default `href="/"` behavior

This means:
- If you navigate from the main page (or any page) to a room dashboard, clicking "<-Main" takes you back to that page
- If you open a room dashboard directly (e.g., bookmark), it goes to the main page

The button now uses browser history when available, with a fallback to the main page.

Updated the "<-Main" button to use browser history only if the previous page is from the same site. It:

1. Checks `document.referrer` to see if there's a previous page
2. Compares the referrer's origin with the current page's origin
3. Uses `history.back()` only if they match (same site)
4. Falls back to `href="/"` if:
   - There's no referrer
   - The referrer is from a different origin (external site)
   - URL parsing fails

This ensures the button never navigates to an external site and only uses browser history when safe.
